family: The OR family: f_0(empty input)=0; for every n>=1, f_n(x_1,...,x_n)=x_1 OR ... OR x_n, the characteristic function of the total language L={x in {0,1}* : x contains a 1}. One fixed total family defined at every length, with the uniform linear-time evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier given in proof.md.
theorem: For this one fixed total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)=n-1 for all n>=1 (and C_B2(f_0)=0), so liminf as n tends to infinity of C_B2(f_n)/n >= 1 in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n=|x|. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*n for every integer n>=N_epsilon.
